issues.issue: Was the Officer's use of the application date, rather than the refugee-claim date under s. 25.1(9), as the lock-in date for the son's age reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: Subsection 25.1(9) should apply, using the refugee-claim date; the 2017 amendments made the transitional provisions meaningless; Mehmood supports this.
issues.respondent_position: Transitional provisions apply because the claim was in progress before August 1, 2014; Fortis governs; the Temporary Policy does not change this.
issues.result_quote: it was reasonable for the Officer to rely on the transitional provisions of the IRPR and to use the date of the Application as the lock-in date
